title: Protocol to Culture mESCs
author: Stefano D Vianello
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7xbhpin

steps.title: Prepare Solutions and Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary reagents and containers for the cell collection process.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 6mL of 10% Serum Medium for washing and resuspension.
Prepare 2mL of '10% Serum 2i/LIF' medium consisting of 10% Serum Medium supplemented with 3uM CHIR99021 (1:1000 from 3mM stock), 1uM PD0325901 (1:500 from stock), and 100u/mL LIF (1:1000 from stock).
Prepare one empty 15mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Wash and Digest Cells
steps.instruction: Remove culture medium and digest cells using Accutase.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate all culture medium from the well using a vacuum pump and glass pipette, ensuring cells are not completely dried out.
Wash the well by adding 2mL PBS-/- against the side of the well, then aspirate it out.
Add 500uL Accutase and let digest for approximately 3 minutes at room temperature, or until most cells are detached.
Softly tap the side of the plate to aid the detachment of loosely-adherent cells.

steps.title: Collect Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the dissociated cells from the well into the Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Using a P1000, pipette the suspension repeatedly up and down (avoiding bubbles) and use the liquid to wash the well surface to collect as many cells as possible.
Transfer the collected cells to the 15mL Falcon tube.
Wash the well one last time with 4.5mL 10% Serum Medium and add this to the Falcon tube, bringing the total volume to approximately 5mL.

steps.title: Pellet and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Concentrate the cells via centrifugation and resuspend them for counting.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 200 x g (1000rpm) for 4 minutes at 4 °C.
Verify that a pellet has formed at the bottom of the tube.
Remove all medium using a vacuum pump and glass pasteur pipette.
Resuspend the pellet in 1mL 10% Serum Medium by pipetting up and down ~20 times with a P1000.
Switch to a P200 and pipette up and down again ~20 times to further break down cell clumps.

steps.title: Count Cells
steps.instruction: Determine cell concentration using a haemocytometer.

substeps.instruction: Using a P10 or P20 pipette, pipette the suspension up and down ~5 times.
Load 10uL of the suspension into a haemocytometer chamber.
Tally cells in the four 4x4 squares at the corners of the central cross.
Calculate concentration: (Total cells / 4) * 10,000 = cells/mL.

steps.title: Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Seed the cells into a prepared well and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 2mL of the prepared 10% Serum/2iLIF medium to a new well of a 6-well plate and place in the incubator to equilibrate.
Calculate the volume of cell suspension needed to reach 70k cells and plate them into the equilibrated well.
Slide the plate back and forth in a cross pattern across the laminar flow cabinet surface to distribute cells evenly.
Leave cells undisturbed in the incubator to allow attachment.

steps.title: Maintain Culture
steps.instruction: Perform regular maintenance and splitting of the cells.

substeps.instruction: Split cells every 2 or 3 days without medium changes in between.
Perform daily checks to monitor for overcrowding or other issues.
